title: Git Branch Merging Strategy
definition: The approach to managing and merging multiple branches in a Git repository.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A way to combine changes from different branches in a Git repository, ensuring the final result is coherent and doesn't lose important information.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A strategy for merging branches in Git, involving pulling and pushing changes between branches to keep both branches and the repository as a whole updated and synchronized.
difficulty_levels.expert: A philosophical exploration of branch management in Git, examining the implications of different merging strategies, edge cases, and best practices to maintain a well-organized and functional repository.

extra_fields.insight: The importance of a thoughtful and efficient branch merging strategy in collaborative Git workflows.
